title: Floods: Cop car swept away in Kuchai Lama, occupants unhurt | The Star
text:
Floods: Cop car swept away in Kuchai Lama, occupants unhurt | The Star
KUALA LUMPUR: A police patrol car was swept away by flood waters at Kuchai Lama here on Monday (March 7).
Brickfields OCPD Asst Comm Amihizam Abdul Shukor said the vehicle was parked near a police booth at about 3.30pm on Monday (March 7) as the two policemen wanted to perform their prayers.
